pawapay.description: Mobile money aggregator with pan-African coverage (11+ countries).
pawapay.descriptionLong: PawaPay aggregates 42+ Mobile Money operators across 11 sub-Saharan African countries. Ideal for merchants needing broad continental coverage through a single integration.

fedapay.description: Accept Mobile Money and cards in West Africa (UEMOA).
fedapay.descriptionLong: FedaPay is a francophone payment gateway based in Benin, present in Benin, Togo, Senegal, Ivory Coast, Niger, Mali and Guinea. A good option for UEMOA merchants requiring local support.

feexpay.description: Mobile Money & card gateway focused on Benin and francophone Africa.
feexpay.descriptionLong: FeexPay offers Mobile Money and card collection in Benin, Togo, Senegal, Congo, Burkina Faso and Ivory Coast, with built-in 2FA on sensitive operations.

kkiapay.description: Simple payment solution for Benin, Ivory Coast, Togo and Senegal.
kkiapay.descriptionLong: KKiaPay is a popular Mobile Money aggregator in Benin, Ivory Coast, Togo and Senegal. Client-side widget, programmable payouts, HMAC-signed webhooks.

ipay_money.description: Mobile Money collection in Benin and Niger (payment only).
ipay_money.descriptionLong: iPay Money is a Mobile Money acquirer in Benin and Niger. Note: iPay Money supports inbound payments (collection) only, no outbound transfers.

paydunya.description: Mobile Money aggregator for francophone Africa (UEMOA + CEMAC).
paydunya.descriptionLong: PayDunya covers Benin, Ivory Coast, Senegal, Mali, Burkina Faso and Cameroon. Includes a two-step redistribution (payout) API for compliance.

hub2_ci.descriptionLong: Hub2 aggregates operators (Orange CI, MTN CI, Moov CI, Wave CI) behind a unified API. Hub2 account registered separately for Ivory Coast; credentials are country-specific.

hub2_sn.descriptionLong: Hub2 aggregates operators (Orange SN, Free Money, Wave SN) behind a unified API. Hub2 account registered separately for Senegal; credentials are country-specific.

hub2_bj.descriptionLong: Hub2 aggregates operators (MTN BJ, Moov BJ, Celtiis) behind a unified API. Hub2 account registered separately for Benin; credentials are country-specific.

hub2_ml.descriptionLong: Hub2 aggregates operators (Orange ML, Moov ML) behind a unified API. Hub2 account registered separately for Mali; credentials are country-specific.

hub2_cm.descriptionLong: Hub2 aggregates operators (MTN CM, Orange CM) behind a unified API. Hub2 account registered separately for Cameroon; credentials are country-specific. XAF currency (BEAC), distinct from XOF.

hub2_tg.descriptionLong: Hub2 aggregates operators (MTN TG, Moov TG, T-Money) behind a unified API. Hub2 account registered separately for Togo; credentials are country-specific.

hub2_bf.descriptionLong: Hub2 aggregates operators (Orange BF, Moov BF, MTN BF) behind a unified API. Hub2 account registered separately for Burkina Faso; credentials are country-specific.

pal_africa.description: Pan-African meta-PSP (UEMOA + CEMAC + Nigeria + Ghana), a single account for 8 countries.
pal_africa.descriptionLong: PAL Africa (pals.africa) aggregates Mobile Money operators across 7 UEMOA/CEMAC countries (Benin, Ivory Coast, Senegal, Togo, Mali, Burkina Faso, Cameroon) under a single API key pair. Also includes mobile payouts to Ghana (MTN, Airtel) and bank transfers in Nigeria. Transaction status via polling (`/getcollection`, `/gettransfer`) or webhook (unsigned, verified on our side by re-fetching status; see integration doc).

paystack.description: Hosted-checkout gateway for 5 African countries: cards, MoMo, EFT, USSD.
paystack.descriptionLong: Paystack (paystack.com) covers Nigeria (NGN), Ghana (GHS), South Africa (ZAR), Kenya (KES) and Ivory Coast (XOF), with announced beta rollouts in Egypt (EGP) and Rwanda (RWF). Methods: Visa/Mastercard cards, Mobile Money (MTN, Telecel, AirtelTigo, M-Pesa, Wave, Orange), Nigerian USSD, South African EFT, Nigerian bank transfers. Native refunds + payouts via API. HMAC-SHA512-signed webhooks with a documented IP allowlist (52.31.139.75, 52.49.173.169, 52.214.14.220). Native idempotency via the `reference` field. A Stripe subsidiary since 2020, but with a distinct API.

paytech.description: Hosted-checkout MoMo + card gateway for 4 UEMOA countries (SN, CI, ML, BJ).
paytech.descriptionLong: PayTech (paytech.sn) is a Senegalese gateway covering Senegal (Orange, Wave, Free, Wizall, E-Money), Ivory Coast (Orange, MTN, Moov, Wave), Mali (Orange, Moov), Benin (MTN, Moov) and Visa/Mastercard cards. Hosted checkout only (redirect to paytech.sn/payment/checkout/...), no direct push-to-pay. Native MoMo payouts, native refunds. Doubly signed webhook (HMAC-SHA256 + SHA256 of credentials), the driver accepts either method.

payplus.description: Mobile Money + card gateway for 4 UEMOA countries (Benin, Togo, Burkina, Ivory Coast).
payplus.descriptionLong: PayPlus (payplus.africa) is a Beninese gateway covering Benin (MTN, Moov), Togo (Moov), Burkina Faso (Orange, Onatel) and Ivory Coast (MTN). Also accepts Visa / Mastercard / Amex cards on its checkout page. Two flows: hosted checkout (redirect, available in sandbox + live) and direct push-to-pay (straight, live only). Unsigned webhooks, verified on our side by re-fetching status via /confirm. No payout API.

cryptomus.description: Crypto payments and payouts (BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, 100+), fees from 0.4%.
cryptomus.descriptionLong: Cryptomus is a crypto-currency payment and payout gateway covering 100+ assets (BTC, ETH, USDT TRC20/ERC20, USDC, SOL, TRX, LTC…). Hosted-checkout flow only (pay.cryptomus.com/pay/{uuid}), the customer picks their crypto and network on the Cryptomus page. Worldwide coverage, no country restrictions. Native refunds via API. MD5-signed webhook embedded in the body (unique pattern), single source IP to allowlist (91.227.144.54).

qosic.description: Mobile Money + card gateway for Benin and Togo (MTN, Moov, Celtiis, Togocel).
qosic.descriptionLong: QOSPAY (qosic.com) is a Benin-based payment gateway covering Benin (MTN, Moov, Celtiis) and Togo (Togocel/Yas, Moov Togo). Authentication via HTTP Basic. Quirk: 5 distinct payment endpoints depending on the operator (URL routing by operator in the driver), plus a distinct `clientid` per operator that the merchant must configure (Qosic issues one clientid per MoMo subscription). Native refunds via API. ⚠ Webhook is UNSIGNED, Qosic does not publish a signature algorithm; the driver systematically verifies via status re-fetch (`gettransactionstatus`) after each callback to prevent forgeries. Sandbox over HTTP `staging.qosic.net:9010` (production must be HTTPS via the URL provided on the merchant dashboard).

notchpay.description: Hosted-checkout MoMo + card gateway for 5 African countries (CM, NG, GH, KE, ZA), native refunds.
notchpay.descriptionLong: Notch Pay (notchpay.co) is a Cameroonian payment gateway covering Cameroon (MTN, Orange Money + cards), Nigeria, Ghana (MTN, Telecel, AirtelTigo), Kenya (M-Pesa) and South Africa (cards). Hosted-checkout by default (the customer picks the operator on the Notch Pay page); a direct push-to-pay flow is also available in 2-step mode via /payments then /payments/{ref} with channel + phone. Native refunds (full or partial) via POST /refunds. Payouts via /beneficiaries (create) then /transfers (send). Dual-header auth (`Authorization: pk_*` + `X-Grant: sk_*` for sensitive ops). HMAC-SHA256-signed webhook over the raw body, header `X-Notch-Signature`, per-webhook secret separate from the API key.

magma_onepay.description: Francophone MoMo gateway (UEMOA + CEMAC + Guinea), 8 countries, Wave CI included.
magma_onepay.descriptionLong: Magma OnePay (magmaonepay.com) is a Mobile Money gateway built on magmasend.com, covering 8 francophone African countries: Benin, Ivory Coast, Senegal, Togo, Mali, Burkina Faso, Cameroon and Guinea. Channels: mobile_money (operator auto-detection via the payee prefix), Wave (Ivory Coast), credit_card (collection) and bank_account (payout). Native payin + payout APIs with multi-country balance and transfer history. Auth via two headers (`Authorization: Bearer` + `X-User-Secret`). HMAC-SHA256-signed webhook in the `X-SIGNATURE` header (the same private_key serves as both auth AND HMAC secret). No published IP allowlist, the signature is the sole line of defense. No documented refund API; refunds must be issued via the Magma dashboard.

coinbase_commerce.description: Accept BTC, ETH, LTC, BCH and USDC, price shown in XAF/XOF/NGN/GHS/USD/EUR, settlement in crypto.
coinbase_commerce.descriptionLong: Coinbase Commerce (commerce.coinbase.com) is Coinbase's hosted crypto checkout for international merchants. Accepts payments in Bitcoin (BTC), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Ethereum (ETH), Litecoin (LTC) and USD Coin (USDC). The merchant sets the price IN A LOCAL CURRENCY (XAF, XOF, NGN, GHS, USD, EUR), Coinbase computes the crypto equivalent at the current rate. SETTLEMENT to the merchant happens IN CRYPTO (the merchant's Coinbase wallet receives BTC/ETH/etc.), or in USDC if the Auto-Convert option is enabled on the Coinbase dashboard. Final fiat conversion is the merchant's responsibility (Coinbase Business / external off-ramp). Worldwide coverage (30+ countries, including CEMAC + UEMOA + NG + GH + USA + EU). No payout API (capabilities = payment only). No refund API (crypto refunds are issued manually via the Coinbase dashboard). HMAC-SHA256-signed webhook over the raw body, header `X-CC-Webhook-Signature`. No published IP allowlist (Coinbase uses a CDN), the HMAC signature is the sole line of defense. 1% fee on Coinbase's side, to pass on to the merchant.

stripe.description: Visa / Mastercard / Amex cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay internationally.
stripe.descriptionLong: Stripe is the reference aggregator for international card payments. 130+ currency coverage (USD, EUR, GBP, XOF…), with native wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link) auto-enabled. Typical use case: an African merchant who wants to charge an international customer base by card.

flutterwave.description: Mobile Money in 11 countries + bank payouts in USD/EUR/GBP/NGN/GHS/INR, pan-African gateway.
flutterwave.descriptionLong: Flutterwave (flutterwave.com) is one of the largest African payment aggregators, covering Mobile Money in 11 countries (BF, CM, CI, GH, KE, RW, SN, TZ, UG, ZM + Malawi/Ethiopia for payout only) and bank-payout in 11 currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, NGN, GHS, ZAR, INR, EGP, ETB, MWK, AUD). v4 API uses OAuth 2.0 client_credentials with a short-lived token (10 min), the driver handles caching + refresh. Orchestrator flow (POST /orchestration/direct-charges) bundles customer + payment_method + charge into a single API call. HMAC-SHA256-signed webhook in the `flutterwave-signature` header using the merchant's « secret hash ». Native refunds via POST /refunds. ⚠ Cards not implemented on the Zayono side (Flutterwave v4 requires RSA-OAEP encryption of the PAN inside the driver, PCI-DSS exposure; deferred).
